details: Bitcoin surged above $78,000, with Ethereum and XRP also showing gains, following President Trump's announcement of an indefinite extension of the US-Iran ceasefire. This de-escalation of geopolitical tensions has reduced market risk aversion, contributing to increased institutional demand and positive inflows into Bitcoin ETFs. The development is seen as a short-term relief, driving cryptocurrency prices higher.
title: US-Iran Ceasefire Extension Boosts Crypto Market Sentiment

details: Kevin Warsh, a Federal Reserve Chair nominee, stated during his Senate confirmation hearing that cryptocurrencies are already an integral part of the U.S. financial system and opposed the issuance of a central bank digital currency (CBDC). He also indicated a potential for tighter liquidity by advocating for a reduction in the Fed's balance sheet. Despite these hawkish remarks on monetary policy, Bitcoin demonstrated resilience, maintaining its position above $76,000.
title: Fed Nominee Warsh: Crypto Integrated, Warns on Liquidity

details: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have continued their positive momentum, recording net inflows for the sixth consecutive day and attracting over a quarter-billion dollars this week. This sustained institutional demand is a key factor fueling the current rally in the crypto market. Coupled with easing geopolitical tensions and a "risk-on" sentiment in broader equity markets, these inflows contribute to a bullish outlook for Bitcoin and other digital assets.
title: Strong Bitcoin ETF Inflows Drive Crypto Market Rally

details: The cryptocurrency futures market saw over $420 million in liquidations within the last 24 hours, with approximately 70% ($285 million) comprising short positions. This significant event occurred as Bitcoin's price rose above $78,000. Such extensive short liquidations often indicate increasing short-term upward pressure, suggesting potential for continued bullish momentum if buying interest persists.
title: Crypto Futures Market Liquidates $420M, Shorts Bear Brunt
